mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jobs WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule_applications sa JOIN job_schedules js ON sa.schedule_id = js.id JOIN jobs j ON js.job_id = j.id WHERE j.company_id = #{companyId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule_applications sa JOIN job_schedules js ON sa.schedule_id = js.id JOIN jobs j ON js.job_id = j.id WHERE j.company_id = #{companyId} AND sa.status = 'PENDING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule_applications sa JOIN job_schedules js ON sa.schedule_id = js.id JOIN jobs j ON js.job_id = j.id WHERE j.company_id = #{companyId} AND DATE(sa.applied_at) = #{today}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule_shifts WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND shift_date = #{today}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule_shifts WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND shift_date >= #{today} AND status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'CHECKED_OUT', 'COMPLETED')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_records a WHERE a.company_id = #{companyId} AND (a.status IS NOT NULL AND a.status != 'NORMAL' OR a.check_in_time IS NULL OR a.check_out_time IS NULL)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_records WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND settlement_status = 'UNPAID'

SELECT CONCAT('APPLICATION-', sa.id) AS id, 'APPLICATION' AS type, CONCAT(COALESCE(w.name, '工人'), '报名', COALESCE(j.title, '岗位')) AS title, CONCAT(COALESCE(wp.gender, '未知'), ' · ', COALESCE(w.phone, '暂无手机号')) AS description, sa.status AS status, 'HIGH' AS priority, sa.id AS biz_id, 'SCHEDULE_APPLICATION' AS biz_type, '通过报名' AS action_text, '/pages/applications/applicationList' AS route_path, sa.applied_at AS created_at, NULL AS deadline_at FROM schedule_applications sa JOIN job_schedules js ON sa.schedule_id = js.id JOIN jobs j ON js.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN c_worker w ON sa.worker_id = w.id LEFT JOIN worker_profiles wp ON sa.worker_id = wp.worker_id WHERE j.company_id = #{companyId} AND sa.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY sa.applied_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule_applications sa JOIN job_schedules js ON sa.schedule_id = js.id JOIN jobs j ON js.job_id = j.id WHERE j.company_id = #{companyId} AND sa.status = 'PENDING'

SELECT CONCAT('SCHEDULE-', s.id) AS id, 'SCHEDULE' AS type, CONCAT(COALESCE(j.title, '岗位'), '排班待跟进') AS title, CONCAT(s.shift_date, ' ', s.start_time, '-', s.end_time, ' · ', COALESCE(w.name, '未匹配工人')) AS description, s.status AS status, 'MEDIUM' AS priority, s.id AS biz_id, 'SCHEDULE_SHIFT' AS biz_type, '取消排班' AS action_text, '/pages/schedules/scheduleList' AS route_path, s.created_at AS created_at, TIMESTAMP(s.shift_date, s.start_time) AS deadline_at FROM schedule_shifts s JOIN jobs j ON s.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN c_worker w ON s.worker_id = w.id WHERE s.company_id = #{companyId} AND s.shift_date >= #{today} AND s.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'CHECKED_OUT', 'COMPLETED') ORDER BY s.shift_date ASC, s.start_time ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT CONCAT('ATTENDANCE-', a.id) AS id, 'ATTENDANCE' AS type, CONCAT(COALESCE(w.name, '工人'), '考勤异常') AS title, CONCAT(COALESCE(j.title, '岗位'), ' · ', COALESCE(a.status, '缺少打卡')) AS description, COALESCE(a.status, 'EXCEPTION') AS status, 'HIGH' AS priority, a.id AS biz_id, 'ATTENDANCE_RECORD' AS biz_type, '查看处理' AS action_text, '/pages/schedules/scheduleList' AS route_path, a.created_at AS created_at, NULL AS deadline_at FROM attendance_records a JOIN jobs j ON a.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN c_worker w ON a.worker_id = w.id WHERE a.company_id = #{companyId} AND (a.status IS NOT NULL AND a.status != 'NORMAL' OR a.check_in_time IS NULL OR a.check_out_time IS NULL) ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT CONCAT('SALARY-', a.id) AS id, 'SALARY' AS type, CONCAT(COALESCE(w.name, '工人'), '薪资待结算') AS title, CONCAT(COALESCE(j.title, '岗位'), ' · 应付 ', COALESCE(a.payable_pay, a.scheduled_pay, 0)) AS description, a.settlement_status AS status, 'MEDIUM' AS priority, a.id AS biz_id, 'ATTENDANCE_RECORD' AS biz_type, '结算薪资' AS action_text, '/pages/attendance/attendanceList' AS route_path, a.created_at AS created_at, NULL AS deadline_at FROM attendance_records a JOIN jobs j ON a.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN c_worker w ON a.worker_id = w.id WHERE a.company_id = #{companyId} AND a.settlement_status = 'UNPAID' ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_records WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND settlement_status = 'UNPAID'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CONCAT('ATTENDANCE-', a.id) AS id, 'ATTENDANCE' AS type, CONCAT(COALESCE(w.name, '工人'), '考勤异常') AS title, CONCAT(COALESCE(j.title, '岗位'), ' · ', COALESCE(a.status, '缺少打卡')) AS description, COALESCE(a.status, 'EXCEPTION') AS status, 'HIGH' AS priority, a.id AS biz_id, '/pages/schedules/scheduleList' AS route_path, a.created_at AS created_at FROM attendance_records a JOIN jobs j ON a.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN c_worker w ON a.worker_id = w.id WHERE a.company_id = #{companyId} AND (a.status IS NOT NULL AND a.status != 'NORMAL' OR a.check_in_time IS NULL OR a.check_out_time IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('SALARY-', a.id) AS id, 'SALARY' AS type, '薪资待结算' AS title, CONCAT(COALESCE(j.title, '岗位'), ' · 应付 ', COALESCE(a.payable_pay, a.scheduled_pay, 0)) AS description, a.settlement_status AS status, 'MEDIUM' AS priority, a.id AS biz_id, '/pages/attendance/attendanceList' AS route_path, a.created_at AS created_at FROM attendance_records a JOIN jobs j ON a.job_id = j.id WHERE a.company_id = #{companyId} AND a.settlement_status = 'UNPAID' ) x ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_records a WHERE a.company_id = #{companyId} AND (a.status IS NOT NULL AND a.status != 'NORMAL' OR a.check_in_time IS NULL OR a.check_out_time IS NULL)) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_records a WHERE a.company_id = #{companyId} AND a.settlement_status = 'UNPAID')

SELECT d.date, COALESCE(app.application_count, 0) AS application_count, COALESCE(shift_count.shift_count, 0) AS shift_count, COALESCE(salary.salary_amount, 0) AS salary_amount FROM ( SELECT #{startDate} + INTERVAL seq DAY AS date FROM ( SELECT 0 AS seq UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 ) seqs ) d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(sa.applied_at) AS date, COUNT(*) AS application_count FROM schedule_applications sa JOIN job_schedules js ON sa.schedule_id = js.id JOIN jobs j ON js.job_id = j.id WHERE j.company_id = #{companyId} AND DATE(sa.applied_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(sa.applied_at) ) app ON app.date = d.date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.shift_date AS date, COUNT(*) AS shift_count FROM schedule_shifts s WHERE s.company_id = #{companyId} AND s.shift_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY s.shift_date ) shift_count ON shift_count.date = d.date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(COALESCE(a.calculated_at, a.created_at)) AS date, SUM(COALESCE(a.payable_pay, a.scheduled_pay, 0)) AS salary_amount FROM attendance_records a WHERE a.company_id = #{companyId} AND DATE(COALESCE(a.calculated_at, a.created_at)) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(COALESCE(a.calculated_at, a.created_at)) ) salary ON salary.date = d.date ORDER BY d.date
